profile.headline: Senior Frontend Software Engineer. Founder of Resume Zap at resumezap.io - a real-time WYSIWYG resume builder.
profile.summary:
Full Stack Web Developer with 10 years of experience in developing large-scale SaaS web
applications in startup and big tech environments.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and built a real-time, fully WYSIWYG resume editor SaaS that works like Google Docs using React, Redux, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, delivering a production-ready platform with global users.
• Implemented direct on-page editing, real-time pagination, dynamic single and double column templates, and 24 customizable sections.
• Engineered the pagination and layout engine to handle real-time content reflow across template changes, fonts, and layouts while maintaining pixel-perfect output and clean page breaks.
• Developed secure and scalable backend services and server-side PDF generation with Puppeteer, and managed end-to-end DevOps on a VPS including automated deployments, monitoring, rate limiting, and caching.
• Integrated Anthropic Claude API to implement an AI-powered writing assistant that rewrites resume contents across five professional tones.

positions.title: Senior System Management Software Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed user interfaces for cluster management workflows, including
creation, upgrade, expansion, and replication, using Cisco’s React-based framework and
micro-frontend architecture. Enhanced application performance and user experience by
integrating reusable UI components.
• Collaborated closely with product managers, UX designers, and cross-functional teams to
prototype and implement new health-check features, resulting in improved system
reliability and user satisfaction.
• Led troubleshooting efforts for customer-reported issues, coordinating with QA engineers
and backend teams to ensure prompt resolution and maintain high application quality.

positions.title: Senior UI/UX Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and optimized log data visualization services for VoIP call scenarios, enabling
customers to debug complex call issues with an interactive call flow-diagram and detailed
multi-level tabular displays. Utilized React, JavaScript/TypeScript, MobX, and Ant Design
Framework to create a responsive and user-friendly interface.
• Collaborated with architects and technical leads to implement a new theme system and
refactor existing business logic, resulting in a more modular and maintainable codebase.
• Created interactive mockups and prototypes using Figma, which facilitated stakeholder
feedback and streamlined the development process. Implemented unit tests with Jest to
ensure code reliability and functionality.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained a private cloud storage management application, focusing on
intricate data visualizations of hardware performance. Utilized React, JavaScript,
Bootstrap, LESS, and Highcharts to create a dynamic and interactive user experience.
• Created reusable in-house components, including highly customized charts and widgets,
which improved development efficiency and consistency across the application.
• Worked closely with QA teams to design and implement automated tests using Selenium,
significantly reducing manual testing efforts and increasing test coverage.
• Collaborated with product teams to design and create interactive mockups for new
features using Photoshop and InVision, ensuring alignment with user needs and design
standards.
